notes.title: Mia's Hunt 0.3.20 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Additional Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cassie's notes now have voiceovers.
[*] New zombie type added.
[*] Added hit effects on zombies after death.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted brightness settings for various lights.
[*] Removed the day and night cycle.
[*] Improved game optimization for better performance.
[*] Changed rifle firing sound.
[*] Arrows now leave trails when fired.
[*] Replaced the bat with a katana.
[*] Stamina now only drains during combat.
[*] The HUD now hides when not in combat.
[*] Shader compilation added at startup to prevent FPS drops at the beginning of each stage.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where zombies would teleport.
[*] Fixed a bug where Mia would warp to dead zombies.
[*] Rex no longer attacks dead enemies.
[/list]

notes.title: Mia's Hunt 0.2.16 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Additional Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new type of zombie.
[*] Weapons now attach to the character and have physics.
[*] Added new voice lines for Mia.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Zombies and plague doctors now leave footprints when walking through snow and puddles.
[*] Removed the blur while aiming.
[*] Updated the water texture.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can climb on trash cans.
[*] Players can no longer roll midair.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused Rex to always spawn next to you upon pressing continue, even if you don't own Rex.
[/list]

notes.title: Mia's Hunt 0.2.14 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Additional Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Customize your movement keys (WASD) directly from the controls menu.
[*] Introducing "Lumen," a setting for realistic lighting and reflections (requires a powerful computer).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759699/ed04d457646da844abe68d3197671cfb0332d56c.png[/img]

Changes:
[list]
[*] Your loyal dog now displays damage numbers when attacking enemies.
[*] Released dog now moves directly to the player and sits.
[*] Lowered the damage required for limb dismemberment.
[*] Increased damage for all ranged weapons.
[*] Story intro sound volume has been reduced.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] No more random invisible blockages affecting player movement.
[*] The dog no longer focuses on zombies after they are defeated.
[*] Zombies will no longer spawn items in the air.
[*] Fixed the issue causing the dog to move slowly towards zombies.
[/list]

[b]Chapter 2 Sneak Peak:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759699/5af50fa255fb468787870e9a96d662c76702a592.png[/img]

notes.title: Mia's Hunt 0.2.10 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Additional Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rare pickup objects now have an overlay.
[*] A Save button has been added to the escape menu.
[*] New highlight effects have been added to pickups.
[*] Upon picking up items, you can now see the current quantity owned in the pickup overlay.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the duration between night-day and weather changes.
[*] Made the flashlight clearer when the user looks up and down.
[*] The flashlight key can now be customized in the controls section.
[*] Improved overall aiming for easier gameplay.
[*] First-person perspective has been removed.
[*] Improved the usage of the Bow.
[*] Improved the camera behavior when colliding with walls.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved the bug where zombies sometimes run away from the player.
[*] Fixed the bug where zombies move backward toward the player.
[*] Fixed the issue where you couldn't close Cassie's note with a gamepad.
[*] Flashlight now works seamlessly with gamepads.
[*] Fixed the bug where Mia's eyes glow when using the flashlight.
[/list]

notes.title: Mia's Hunt 0.2.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Additional Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage numbers are now displayed when hitting enemies.
[*] Partial controller support has been implemented.
[*] Added an additional hidden location with an achievement.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased headshot damage multiplier from 2x to 2.5x.
[*] Clarified the password for unlocking Rex.
[*] Implemented some AI optimizations.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved the issue where some items would disappear with a delay after picking them up.
[*] Fixed the bug preventing items on the rails from being picked up at the train station.
[*] Addressed the bug where praying doctors were not triggered when the player fired at a nearby point.
[/list]

notes.title: Mia's Hunt 0.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Additional Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] The dog will now regenerate health while sitting or lying down.
[*] Two new achievements added: one for completing Chapter 1 and another for finding the train.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Torch attachments location has been moved for easier accessibility.
[*] The loading screen will now remain visible after loading is complete, allowing players to read Chapter 1 text.
[*] The dog hitbox has been increased to ensure zombies won't miss most attacks.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Resolved the issue related to Russian localization causing most text to disappear.[/b]
[*] Fixed the problem where users had to click "close" twice when reading notes from Cassie.
[*] Addressed the issue where plague doctors would attack zombie corpses.
[/list]

notes.title: Mia's Hunt 0.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Additional Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] New sound added when entering the right digit on Rex's lock.
[*] Screen effect now signals low health after taking damage.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Landscape painting introduced using the spray can.
[*] Dog outline visible only when distant.
[*] Added a hint message for the spray can to avoid confusion.
[*] Overall night-time brightness increased.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Hope items no longer pickable twice on low FPS and interaction key spam.
[*] Fixed bug where some factory walls couldn't be painted.
[/list]
